claim: On November 7, 2022 ElastiCache for Memcached gained IPv6 support: you can configure a cluster to accept only IPv4 connections, only IPv6 connections, or both (dual-stack). IPv6 is supported for Memcached engine version 1.6.6 onward on all instances built on the Nitro system, with no additional charges.
question: When did ElastiCache add IPv6 and dual-stack clusters for Memcached, and which versions support it?

values.spoken: Memcached one point six point six onward

qualifiers.scope: ElastiCache for Memcached clusters on Nitro instances
